assets.name: Shape Set 2D + 3D
assets.purpose: A set of 30 paper shape tokens (mix of 2D and 3D) for sorting by attribute. Used in Lessons 1 and 5.
assets.page_layout: Two letter pages, portrait orientation. Each page holds 15 shapes in a 3x5 grid.

image_placeholders.description: Two letter portrait pages of mixed shape tokens for a Grade 1 manipulative, B&W line art. Each page holds 15 tokens in a 3x5 grid. Mix of 2D outlines (squares, triangles, circles, rectangles, hexagons) and 3D shaded illustrations (cubes, cones, spheres, cylinders, pyramids). Each token ~1.5in across with thin solid cut-lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M1_SHAPES: instructions describe a 30-token shape set used in lessons 1 and 5. Keywords name the visual elements (shapes) and activity (sort).

teacher_prep_steps: Print 10 sets total (1 per pair). Each set is 2 pages = 30 tokens.
Laminate before cutting.
Cut along the grid lines into 30 individual tokens per set.
Store each set in a labelled zip-top bag.

assets.name: Paper 3D Blocks
assets.purpose: A set of 12 paper-fold 3D blocks (cubes, cones, cylinders, pyramids, prisms) for building structures. Used in Lessons 2 and 5.
assets.page_layout: Three letter pages, portrait orientation. Each page holds 4 die nets / 3D shape templates.

image_placeholders.description: Three letter portrait pages of paper 3D block templates for a Grade 1 manipulative, B&W line art. Each page holds 4 templates: cube nets, cone unfolds, cylinder rolls, pyramid bases. Fold lines dashed, cut lines solid, tabs for assembly. Each template ~3in across.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M2_BLOCKS: instructions describe a 12-block 3D set for lessons 2 and 5. Keywords name the visual elements (blocks, 3d).

teacher_prep_steps: Print 6 sets (1 per pair plus 2 extras). Each set is 3 pages = 12 blocks.
Cut along solid lines and fold along dashed lines.
Tape or glue tabs to assemble each block.
Store each pair's set in a labelled box.

assets.name: Symmetry Shape Set
assets.purpose: A set of 16 paper shape halves for matching-halves activities. Used in Lessons 3 and 5.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, portrait orientation. 16 half-shapes in a 4x4 grid (8 matched pairs).

image_placeholders.description: A 4x4 grid of 16 shape halves for a Grade 1 manipulative, B&W line art. Each cell ~1.5in × 1.5in showing one half of a symmetric shape (heart-half, butterfly-half, etc.) so children can pair them. Thin solid cut-lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M3_SYMMETRY: instructions describe 16 shape-halves for lessons 3 and 5. Keywords name the activity.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 10 sets (1 per pair).
Laminate before cutting.
Cut into 16 individual half-shapes per set.
Store each set in a labelled bag.

assets.name: Treasure Map Mat
assets.purpose: A letter-size treasure map with grid cells for placing tokens and giving directions. Used in Lessons 4 and 5.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, landscape orientation. Map shows Canadian-themed landmarks: cabin (left), maple tree (right), lake (bottom), snow hill (top-right). Grid of 6×4 cells overlaid.

image_placeholders.description: A landscape treasure map for a Grade 1 manipulative, B&W line art. Features Canadian landmarks: cabin on the left, large maple tree on the right, lake at the bottom-centre, snow-covered hill at top-right. Overlaid on the map is a 6×4 grid of square cells (~1in each) with thin grid lines for placing tokens or planning directions.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M4_MAP: instructions describe a treasure map mat for lessons 4 and 5. Keywords name the visual elements.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 12 mats (1 per pair plus 2 extras).
Laminate for repeated dry-erase use.
Distribute one mat per pair.

assets.name: Treasure Tokens
assets.purpose: A set of 12 small treasure tokens (gold, silver, gem, key) for hiding on the map. Used in Lessons 4 and 5.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, portrait orientation. 12 tokens in a 3x4 grid.

image_placeholders.description: A 3x4 grid of 12 treasure tokens for a Grade 1 manipulative, B&W line art. Tokens: 3 gold coins, 3 silver coins, 3 gems, 3 keys. Each token ~1.5in across with thin cut-lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M5_TOKENS: instructions describe 12 treasure tokens for lessons 4 and 5. Keywords name the visual elements.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 10 sets (1 per pair).
Laminate before cutting.
Cut into 12 tokens per set.
Store with the Treasure Map Mat.

assets.name: Treasure Trail Template
assets.purpose: A letter-size capstone template with map, direction lines, and reflection. Used in Lesson 5.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, portrait orientation. Top half: trail map with grid. Bottom half: 5 station response areas.

image_placeholders.description: A portrait capstone template for a Grade 1 worksheet, B&W line art. Top: a trail map with START square (bottom-left) and TREASURE square (top-right) on a 6×4 grid. Bottom: 5 station response areas stacked: SORT (small sort area), BUILD (drawing space), MATCH (3 small shapes), LOCATE (3 sentence-frame lines), MOVE (3 numbered direction lines).
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M6_CAPSTONE: instructions describe a 5-station capstone template for Lesson 5. Keywords name the activity.

teacher_prep_steps: Print 25 templates (1 per child plus 5 extras).
Stack near the teacher table.
No lamination needed.

assets.name: Position Words Chart

assets.name: Direction Cards

assets.name: Map It Move It Poster

assets.page_layout: One letter page, landscape orientation. Header: 'Map It, Move It!' Centre: Tig and Coco.

Cheerful exploratory tone.

assets.name: Trekker Tig Puppet
assets.purpose: A paper puppet of Trekker Tig the Tiger Cub used by the teacher in the Minds-On phase of every lesson.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, portrait orientation. Single full-body cutout of Tig (~7in tall).

image_placeholders.description: A full-body cutout of Trekker Tig the Tiger Cub in B&W line art for a Grade 1 teacher puppet, ~7in tall. Tig is a young tiger cub with stripes, wearing a small explorer's hat and a backpack with a hiking patch. Holds a walking stick. Bright eyes, curious expression. Rectangular tab at the bottom (~2in wide) for popsicle stick.

assets.name: Compass Coco Puppet
assets.purpose: A paper puppet of Compass Coco the Cat used by the teacher in Lessons 3-5 for direction-giving demos.
assets.page_layout: One letter page, portrait orientation. Single full-body cutout of Coco (~6in tall).

overall_prep_notes: Total prep time ~3.5 hours one-time before unit launch (laminating + cutting + assembling 3D blocks). Storage: keep all pair sets in labelled zip-top bags. Set up all anchor charts and the unit poster on Day 1. The 3D blocks (M2) are the most time-consuming prep — start there.
